title: Longest Continuous Active Days
description:
A wildlife research lab monitors tagged animals in a nature reserve. Each time a sensor detects an animal, it logs an integer representing the relative day number of the observation (e.g., day -2, day 0, day 5). Due to network delays, the recorded logs arrive in an unsorted list and may contain duplicate entries for the same day.

To analyze uninterrupted tracking periods, the research team needs to find the maximum number of consecutive days on which the animal was detected. You are given an array of integers `day_logs` representing all recorded observation days. Return the length of the longest consecutive sequence of days present in the logs.

Your solution must run in $O(n)$ time complexity.
input_format: An integer array `day_logs` containing unsorted day relative numbers.
output_format: An integer representing the length of the longest contiguous sequence of recorded days.

examples.explanation: The longest sequence of consecutive days recorded is [102, 103, 104, 105], which has a length of 4. Another sequence is [1, 2, 3] with length 3.
There are no day logs present, so the longest streak of consecutive days is 0.
After ignoring duplicate entries, the sequence [-3, -2, -1, 0] forms the longest consecutive chain of 4 days.
